title: Beef Labeling Clarity Act
latestAction: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry.
summary:
Beef Labeling Clarity Act 

This bill revises labels for beef and beef food products. Specifically, the bill replaces the Product of U.S.A. voluntary label with the following voluntary labels: Processed in U.S.A.; Raised and Processed in U.S.A.; and Born, Raised, and Processed in U.S.A.

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry.
